name: Buddha
overview: The Bible directs glory and honor solely to the LORD, emphasizing His mercy and truth rather than any human philosophy or figure (Psalms 115:1). While historical figures like Nicodemus, a Jewish ruler, sought understanding (John 3:1), Jesus clearly declares Himself as the exclusive way to the Father, embodying the truth and life (John 14:6). This teaching underscores that salvation and ultimate truth are found only in Christ, not in any alternative religious teachers such as Buddha.
